title: Grand Canyon ATV Tour
includes: Hotel pick-up and drop off (from select hotels)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Tour 6-7 hours from pick up to drop off, depending upon traffic and add ons on site.

Helmets are required and must be worn on tour. If your hair cannot fit within it, if you cannot take your hair down, or if you cannot remove religious headwear, you will not be able to participate and NO REFUNDS will be given.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Head out of Las Vegas for a day of fun and adventure. After hotel pickup by van, enjoy a stop at the Hoover Dam Bypass for great photo ops! Then continue on to our property, close to the Grand canyon's West Rim. From here, you'll enjoy a 1 Hour ride through the Joshua Tree Forest around the Ranch! Includes a meal and roundtrip transportation by van from your Las Vegas hotel.
